title: Borrow subtraction as a fold
statement: For every incoming Boolean borrow flag and Boolean word, sweeping the word from left to right with the local rule that sends a carry $c$ and bit $b$ to carry $c \wedge \lnot b$ and output bit $b \oplus c$ yields the same final carry and output word as the fixed-width borrow subtraction.
hypotheses_covered: The incoming borrow flag is Boolean
The input word is a Boolean word
replaced:
The fixed-width borrow subtraction equals the left fold of the local rule
sending a carry flag $c$ and a bit $b$ to the new carry $c \wedge \lnot b$ and
the output bit $b \oplus c$.
